compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: The movement from victory song to thirst is abrupt. Moses cries to Yahweh, the water becomes drinkable, and the journey continues to abundant water at Elim.
observations.label: Bitter water after the song

observations.body: The passage presents Complaint and cry as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Complaint and cry

observations.body: The passage places Marah and Elim beside Complaint and cry.
observations.label: Marah and Elim

payload.posture: Read Exodus 15:22–27 as one movement in Moses's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.title: Bitter water after the song
